pieces.title: CRISPR/dCas9-Dnmt3a-mediated targeted DNA methylation of APP rescues brain pathology in a mouse model of Alzheimer’s disease
pieces.whatItShows: dCas9-DNMT3A methylates APP promoter in vitro/in vivo; lowers APP/Aβ and improves pathology/behavior in APP-KI mice.

pieces.title: Folic Acid Inhibits Amyloid β-Peptide Production through Modulating DNA Methyltransferase Activity in N2a-APP Cells
pieces.whatItShows: Raising DNMT activity lowers Aβ in N2a-APP cells; DNMT inhibition raises Aβ — DNMT board wires to APP product.

pieces.title: Homeostatic DNMT3a Activity Is Required to Restore Cognition and Hippocampal DNA Methylation in the 5xFAD Model of Alzheimer’s Disease
pieces.whatItShows: DNMT3A knockdown/overexpression both harm cognition; methyl supplementation needs DNMT3A for pro-cognitive/amyloid effects in 5xFAD.

pieces.title: OpenTargets APP Alzheimer rails (live-cached association board)
pieces.whatItShows: APP tops Alzheimer disease association (~0.81) — disease rail the DNMT3A tools act on.
